# Quicksand

Quicksand Bold supplies the outlined `ephir` lettering in the approved Figma
wordmark, exported as `website/src/main/resources/static/design/*/wordmark.svg`.
The site does not load or bundle a Quicksand font file.

Project: https://github.com/andrew-paglinawan/QuicksandFamily

License source: https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/quicksand/OFL.txt
